brief:
Israeli occupation forces raided the village of Marka south of Jenin on Saturday morning, injuring an elderly man and a child during the operation, Shehab Wire reported. The incursion was one of several carried out across multiple towns and villages throughout Jenin governorate on the same day.

Security forces arrested six Palestinians during the series of raids and home invasions that swept the area. Medical sources confirmed the two casualties sustained during the Marka operation, though specific details about the nature and severity of their injuries were not immediately available.
